name: Hardcover
shortDescription: Self-hosted book metadata server for Readarr community forks, sourcing curated data from the Hardcover API and caching it in PostgreSQL.

alerts.message: Set HARDCOVER_AUTH to your Hardcover API token, including the leading "Bearer ", from Hardcover > Settings > Hardcover API. The token expires every January 1 and must be regenerated.

Hardcover metadata is not compatible with existing Readarr databases: it needs a Hardcover-enabled Readarr fork and a fresh library. Point that instance's Metadata Provider Source at this deployment's https:// address.
